command: set -euo pipefail; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(whoami); echo NOW=$(date -Is); echo VOICE_PROCESSES; ps -ef | grep -E '[r]ealtime_gespraech|[v]oice_full_runtime|[g]espraechsmodus' || true; echo VOICE_SERVICES; systemctl --user --no-pager --plain list-units --type=service --all | grep -Ei 'frankenstein|gespraech|voice|realtime' || true; echo CHECKOUTS; for d in /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then echo DIR=$d; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD; git -C "$d" status --short; fi; done; echo DEFAULT_INSTALL_REFERENCES; grep -R --line-number --exclude-dir=.git 'FRANK_VOICE_DEFAULT_INSTALLATION' /home/ai-core-node/.config/systemd/user /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo 2>/dev/null | head -40 || true; echo RETRIEVAL_PROBE; cd /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein 2>/dev/null || cd /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo; PYTHONPATH=scripts:DEV_SOURCE_RESEARCH/repository/scripts python3 -c "import stern,os; print('stern',stern.__file__); print('db',stern.DB_PATH,os.path.exists(stern.DB_PATH)); r=stern.automatischer_abruf('diag-999-omega','GRID10') or ''; print('retrieval_len',len(r)); print('retrieval_preview',repr(r[:800]))"; echo SESSION_PROBE; PYTHONPATH=scripts:DEV_SOURCE_RESEARCH/repository/scripts python3 -c "import os,voice_full_integration as vfi; s=vfi.VoiceIntegrationSession(); print('env_default',os.environ.get('FRANK_VOICE_DEFAULT_INSTALLATION')); print('selected',s.selected_person); print('binding',s.binding); print(s.identity_active_assembly(emergent_context='DIAG_EMERGENT_MARKER')[:1600])"
